# Pages, Security and Refresh Checklist: ADO Simulator Board

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of sign-in and sessions, page security, refresh behaviour,
accessibility and the boundary with the 015 API, for the reviewer at Gate 2 (plan review)
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Sign-in and sessions

- [ ] CHK001 - Is it specified how the service account is identified so it is never offered or signed in, given the 015 seed has no such marker (research R-03 adds `service: true`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the minimum length or strength of a page password and of the shared demo password stated in the spec, not only in the contracts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, contracts/cli-settings-seed.md]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is "one message that does not say which part was wrong" extended to timing (comparable work for every failure), and is that requirement measurable? [Measurability, Spec §US1-3, research R-03]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for repeated failed sign-ins (rate limiting or lockout), or is their absence an explicit decision for a local simulator? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the session lifetime defined as absolute or idle ("idle beyond its lifetime" in US1-5 vs "expiry = created + TTL" in the data model)? [Conflict, Spec §US1-5, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is it specified what happens to open sessions when a user's page password is cleared or their token revoked (kept until expiry, or ended)? [Gap, Spec §US1-6]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the `next` parameter after sign-in restricted to local paths in the requirements (open-redirect protection), not only in the contract? [Coverage, contracts/pages.md]

## Page security

- [ ] CHK008 - Do the requirements state which responses carry security headers (CSP, nosniff, referrer policy, no-store) and which are exempt? [Completeness, contracts/pages.md]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the CSRF requirement defined for the sign-in form, which has no session yet? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is escaping required for every rendered value, including field values of any type (identities, dates, numbers) and error messages echoing input? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is it specified whether the description is shown as text or as sanitised HTML in 017, and is that consistent with 018's form? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the boundary between API authentication (tokens, 401) and page authentication (sessions, redirect) stated for paths under `/{org}/{project}/` that are not under `/_apis/`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, contracts/pages.md]

## Board and refresh

- [ ] CHK013 - Is "the process's order" of columns defined (the seed's state list order) and is the position of the "other" column for unknown states stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the card's "last changer" defined (the latest revision's changer, including the platform's service account)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are refresh requirements consistent between "keep scroll position" and a columns fragment that may grow or shrink? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the behaviour of the create form defined when the board is filtered on an area the new Epic is not in? [Edge Case, Spec §US4-3]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is it specified whether the board type's items outside any area filter (no area) are shown when no filter is chosen? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-002 ("within the refresh interval plus 1 second") consistent with the default 5 s interval and the measured fragment time of SC-001? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]

## Accessibility

- [ ] CHK019 - Can FR-016 and SC-005 be verified with the static checker the plan chooses (research R-09), or do they need a browser-based check, and is the difference stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the refresh's effect on screen readers specified (does a refresh announce changes, or stay silent)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-016]

## Boundaries and data

- [ ] CHK021 - Is it a requirement that page routes stay out of the published OpenAPI document and that 015's contract fixtures are unchanged? [Gap, research R-01]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the attribution requirement (SC-003) defined for every page action, including sign-in and sign-out (which change no work item)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are the seed's board settings validated against the process with named refusals, and is a seed without a `board` section a supported case? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the logging requirement (FR-015) explicit that page form values (title, description, credential) never appear in logs, including on refusal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §SC-004]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
